def stamp_window(events, start, end):
    """Select events in the half-open window [start, end) and stamp them.

    events: list of strings "HH:MM Name" (24-hour, zero-padded hour and minute).
    start and end are "HH:MM" strings. An event at exactly end is excluded.
    If start is later than end the window wraps midnight: keep events in
    [start, 24:00) or [00:00, end). If start equals end, return [].
    Return a list of strings in input order, each formatted exactly as
    "HHMM|name" -- four digits, no colon, a single pipe, then the name
    lowercased with surrounding whitespace stripped. Return [] when none match.
    """
    out = []
    for ev in events:
        time, name = ev.split(None, 1)
        if start <= time <= end:
            out.append(f"{time} {name.strip()}")
    return out

from src.shifts import stamp_window

def names(rows):
    out = []
    for line in rows:
        if not isinstance(line, str):
            raise AssertionError(f"expected str, got {type(line)}")
        if "|" in line:
            out.append(line.split("|", 1)[1].strip().lower())
        else:
            out.append(line.split()[-1].strip().lower())
    return out
